name: migrate_configs_v2
description: Rewrites every *.json service config in a directory in place from v1 to v2 format (service{name,port}, boolean debug, hosts array, timeoutMs). Skips files already version 2. Returns counts and per-file errors.
whenToUse: When migrating v1 service config files to v2; reusable in other environments.

dir.description: Directory of configs, relative to the project root

provenance.reason: v1->v2 config migration, to be repeated in other environments
